production.note: US model years. First: Lexus USA Newsroom page '2018 Lexus LC 500 Product Information' (16 March 2017). Still on sale: the 2026 LC 500 is the newest model year on the Lexus USA Newsroom at the access date (lexus-us-2026-lc500-release); no opened Lexus page announces an end. The V6 hybrid LC 500h is a different variant and is not part of this record.

body.note: 'The 2026 LC 500 model lineup, including the LC 500 Convertible'. The soft-top LC 500 Convertible joined for the 2021 model year (lexus-us-2021-lc500-convertible-release: 'the 2021 Lexus LC 500 Convertible is ready for showtime on Lexus dealer lots'); it shares the variant name, so it is not a separate record. 2018-2020 were coupe only.

configuration.note: 'V8, aluminum block and cylinder heads'; 'DOHC, 32-valve, Dual VVT-i'

fuel.note: Gasoline direct and port injection (D-4S); recommended fuel '95 RON / 91 AKI'. The hybrid is the separate LC 500h.

transmission.note: '10-speed Sport Direct Shift automatic with paddle shift and manual mode' (torque-converter automatic; no manual offered).

powerHp.note: Quote: "351 kW / 471 HP @ 7,100 rpm" (2019 LC 500 specifications table). The same 471 hp is stated for the 2021 Convertible (lexus-us-2021-lc500-convertible-release: '471 horsepower at 7,100 rpm') and for 2026 (lexus-us-2026-lc500-release: 'The LC 500 has an output of 471 hp and 398 lb.-ft. of peak torque'); no rating change was found.

weightLb.note: Coupe, 10-speed automatic (the only transmission), 2019 model. Quote: "1,935kg / 4,280 lb." (curb weight row, LC 500 column; the LC 500h is listed separately at 4,435 lb). Lexus's 2018 product-information PDF could not be opened (HTTP 403), so the reference year is 2019, the earliest year with an opened manufacturer figure; MotorWeek's 2018 LC 500 road test prints the same '4,280-lbs.' (motorweek-2018-lc500). The Convertible is heavier; no opened Lexus page gave its curb weight. Lexus's own line does not convert exactly: 1,935 kg is 4,266 lb, and 4,280 lb is 1,941 kg. The pound figure is used as published for the US car.
